verdict.rationale: Dagster's design explicitly prioritizes a seamless local-to-prod dev experience and testability (dagster-comm-8), backed by first-party asset-check tooling for validating data quality before promotion (dagster-docs-3/20/27/36/37) and a local dev CLI (`dg dev`) for running pipelines on a laptop. Community evidence (dagster-comm-2, dagster-comm-9) confirms real-world use of lightweight local destinations like DuckDB alongside Dagster for exactly this workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party docs showing environment-specific resource swapping (e.g., DuckDB in dev vs Snowflake in prod) and independent hands-on verification of the local-test-then-promote flow.
